description: Check which domain names can be registered and what they cost from a live registrar (not DNS or RDAP). Pass exact domains, or a name plus endings. If Nymwell is not connected to a live registrar, this tool refuses sandbox data; use screen_domains for a public-record first pass. Prices are USD for the minimum term; get_quote gives the exact price for a chosen term. Each name has tier (standard or premium) when it can be registered, or reason (domain_unavailable, extension_not_supported, extension_disallows_registration) when it cannot. No sign-in needed.

name.description: A name without an ending, e.g. orbitnotes

tlds.description: Endings to try with name, e.g. ["com","ai","dev"]

name: search_domains
